scripts.//lint:css: Errors, and part of `npm run lint`, since Phase 5. It fails on a colour, a type size, a radius, a shadow, a stacking layer, a font stack, an off-canon breakpoint or an `!important` written anywhere but app/styles/tokens-*.css, which is what makes "a theme is a one-file edit" a checked claim rather than a convention. .stylelintrc.json carries the two commented allowlists it keeps: the token files, which are the one place a value belongs, and the two stylesheets whose `!important` no specificity can replace.
